sentences.text: Shri Madhusudan Yadav appearing on behalf of Advocate General.

Heard on I.A.No.16047/2024, which is first application filed under Section 438(1) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for suspension of jail sentence and grant of bail on behalf of the applicant Applicant has been convicted under Section 7(1) r/w Section 16 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and sentenced to undergo SI for 01 year with fine of Rs.1000/- default stipulation.
Learned counsel for applicant submitted that applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in this case.
The applicant is aged about 60 years old and he is in custody since 20.09.2024.
Impugned judgements suffer from conjectures and surmises.
It is further submitted that final hearing of this revision is likely to take sufficient long time.
Under these circumstances, learned counsel prays that the application for suspension of sentence of the applicant be allowed.
Counsel for the State has opposed the prayer.

Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, contention of learned counsel for the applicant and custody period of the applicant, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

Accordingly, I.A.No.16047/2024 filed on behalf of applicant is allowed, subject to furnishing personal bond by applicant in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only)
with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned trial Court, for his regular appearance before the registry of this Court, the execution of custodial part of the remaining sentence imposed against the applicant shall remain suspended, till the final disposal of this revision.
